models.long_text: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (Q4_K_M GGUF, Apache-2.0) via llama.cpp llama-server

risks: We do not have any definitive off-take or sales agreements with customers, other than an agreement with REalloy.
The Wolfsberg Project's permits are under review due to an appeal, which could delay operations.
We face strong competition from larger, established mining companies which could negatively impact our business.
The number of shares to be issued is uncertain and could lead to significant dilution.
Seismic activity and regulatory non-compliance could cause production delays and financial losses.

growth_drivers: The Company acquired a 70% stake in 60 Degrees North ApS and entered into a 15-year offtake agreement with REalloys.

We expect to focus on rare earths and critical metals to produce strategic products essential for a transition to sustainable low carbon emission technologies for Europe and its western world partners
risks: Substantial doubt exists about our ability to continue as a going concern within one year.
The Directors do not believe it is appropriate to regard realizations of future income tax benefits as probable.
